name: Hitozuma Swimming Club
original_name: 人妻スイミング倶楽部
source:
The protagonist starts working part-time at a swimming school during summer. And working alongside him are lonely married women who are excited at the appearance of a young man.

Noticing that the business isn't doing so well, the protagonist proposes changing swimsuits to something more revealing. While embarrassed, they decide to go through with it anyway.

And so, his everyday life surrounded by tempting women begins.

[Translated from [url=http://www.interheart.co.jp/pcgame/hitozumaswim/story]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，主角开始在游泳学校兼职。与他一起工作的是孤独的已婚妇女，她们对年轻人的出现感到兴奋。

主角发现生意不景气，提议把泳衣换成更暴露的衣服。虽然很尴尬，但他们还是决定继续下去。

就这样，他被诱惑女人包围的日常生活开始了。

[翻译自[url=http://www.interheart.co.jp/pcgame/hitozumaswim/story]官方网站[/url]]
